title: Modern and consistent validation for R
text: predicater standardizes naming API many is_*()/has_*()/are_*() functions, novel ones include: Testing attributes has_attrs_any//filtering attrs_rmv/keep. consistent tests NA, NaN, Inf, finite values, /are_na2(), /are_finite(), is_nan()/is_inf(), e.g. solving .na(NaN) #> TRUE. Expanding test ‘vector type’ ‘collection type’ is_collection(), possibly including environments, pairlists, expression vectors, NULL. is_integer_like(), organizes common test ‘integer-ish’ two modes: "unbounded" - difference round(x) within given tolerance; "bounded" - unbounded + within R integer range. Correctly dealing NaN Inf values, allowing control NA values. Testing names /are_names_valid(), control empty, NA, duplicate invalid names. organized notion ‘object’, merging S4/object bits, S4/object typeof’s class attribute is_object_like() object_system(). compare functions cited previous section. test_*() assert_*() suite introduces ‘menu’ sub-tests shared across functions, focus flexibility, modern reporting errors. example validating integer-like object. Normally one call test_integer(x, ...), defined arguments first visualization purposes. Note sub-tests ‘number/size something’ (len, n_na, etc.) can different specifications (single value, range, set values, custom function). appear many test_*() functions, well set, sentinels, custom, etc. validation, often one call assert_integer(x, ...) validate user input function. Note assert_*() functions allow control conditions’ environment, argument name, others. error describes sub-test reason (possible) failure. Tests defined (e.g. custom = NULL) reported. assert_*() functions return x success, can used pipelines: Note short_circuit = TRUE (default), first failing sub-test raise error, rest left ‘(skip)’.
code: library(predicater)  # Object to be validated: x <- c(1.0, 2.0, 3.0 + 1e-100, 4.0, Inf)  # Defining the sub tests: args <- list(   mode = "unbounded",    # Equal to round(x), within a tolerance (will pass)   mode_tol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),   len = c(1, 10),             # Length must be between 1 and 10 (will pass)   n_dup = 0,                  # No duplicate values allowed (will pass)   n_nan = c(0, -2),           # At most length(x) - 2 NaN values (will pass)   n_na = c(0, 2, 3),          # 0, 2, or 3 NA values (will pass)   n_inf = \(n, l) n/l <= 0.5, # n of Inf <= 50% of total (will pass)   range = c(-5, +5),          # Values between -5 and 5 (will fail)   set = list(yes = c(1), no = c(0)), # Must contain 1, and not 0 (will pass)   sentinels = c("null"), # If not a numeric vector, x can be a NULL sentinel   sorted = "desc",       # Must be sorted in descending order (will fail)   custom = NULL          # Any user-given custom function )  rlang::exec(test_integer, x, !!!args) #> FALSE (not all tests passed) my_fun <- function(x) {     rlang::exec(         assert_integer, x, !!!args,         env = rlang::current_env(), # Shows the error coming from `my_fun()`         short_circuit = FALSE, # Reports all sub-tests, beyond the first fail         args_cnd = list(class = "my_fun_error")     )      # ... code depending on x's integer properties }  try(my_fun(x)) ## Error in my_fun(x) : `x` failed `assert_integer()`: ## ✔ (pass) sentinels: no sentinel values allowed. ## ✔ (pass) type  : must pass `predicater::is_integer_like()`() in "unbounded" ##   mode. ## ✔ (pass) len   : length must be in range 1 to 10. ## ✔ (pass) n_na  : #of NA values must be in set 0, 2, and 3. ## ✔ (pass) n_dup : #of duplicate values must be 0. ## ✔ (pass) n_nan : #of NaN values must be in range 0 to -2. ## ✔ (pass) n_inf : #of Inf values must satisfy a custom function. ## ✖ (fail) range : must be in range -5 to 5. Found Inf. ## ✖ (fail) set   : must be in a custom set. Was not. ## ✖ (fail) sorted: must be in descending order. Did not. ##  ## ℹ See `predicater::assert_integer()` and this condition's `rs_assert_error` ##   attribute for details. mtcars$mpg |>  # Some external data   tan() |>     # Some transformation   assert_double(     range = c(-10, 10), sorted = "asc",     x_name = "tan(mpg)"   ) |>         # Validation   cos() |>     # If passes, continue the pipeline   try() ## Error in (function (...)  : `tan(mpg)` failed `assert_double()`: ## ✔ (pass) sentinels: no sentinel values allowed. ## ✖ (fail) range : must be in range -10 to 10. Found -47.0730006551673. ## • (skip) sorted: skiped given failure. ## ✔ (pass) type  : must pass `predicater::is_double()`. ##  ## ℹ See `predicater::assert_double()` and this condition's `rs_assert_error` ##   attribute for details.
